name: pdf-mcp
description: Full-stack PDF intelligence MCP server — extract, manipulate, annotate, convert, validate, redact, classify, and RAG-search PDFs, with an agentic pdf_do tool.

upload_dir.title: Upload directory
upload_dir.description: Where uploaded PDFs and generated outputs are stored.

rag_store_path.title: LanceDB RAG store path
rag_store_path.description: Directory for the LanceDB vector store used by pdf_rag.

tools.name: pdf_extract
tools.description: Extract text, images, tables, metadata, fonts, links, and outline from a PDF.

tools.name: pdf_manipulate
tools.description: Merge, split, rotate, reorder, delete pages, compress, encrypt, decrypt, optimize.

tools.name: pdf_annotate
tools.description: Watermark, stamp, highlight, underline, header/footer, page numbers, LLM summary box.

tools.name: pdf_forms
tools.description: List, fill, flatten, and export AcroForm fields; LLM-guided auto-fill.

tools.name: pdf_convert
tools.description: Convert PDF to/from Markdown, HTML, and images.

tools.name: pdf_validate
tools.description: PDF/A, structure, accessibility, integrity checks and two-file compare.

tools.name: pdf_rag
tools.description: Chunk, index (LanceDB), semantic search, query-by-example, synthesis, list/delete.

tools.name: pdf_analyze
tools.description: Detect scanned vs digital PDFs with per-page layout statistics.

tools.name: pdf_redact
tools.description: Blacken sensitive terms and PII patterns (email, phone, IBAN, card, SSN, IP).

tools.name: pdf_classify
tools.description: Classify document type (invoice, receipt, report, contract, form, resume, ...).

tools.name: pdf_dedupe
tools.description: Detect exact and near-duplicate PDFs by content fingerprint.

tools.name: pdf_export
tools.description: Build a reusable document brief (Markdown or JSON) with optional LLM summary.

tools.name: pdf_do
tools.description: Chain the PDF tools autonomously from a natural-language task (needs a local LLM).

tools.name: pdf_help
tools.description: List tools, or get the input schema for one tool.

tools.name: pdf_status
tools.description: Server status: version, uptime, tool count, mode.
